 Home Education News UGC NET December 2026: NTA To Close Registrations Tomorrow, Exam In December, Here’s How To Register Through DigiLocker
 UGC NET December 2026: The National Testing Agency (NTA) will close registrations for the UGC NET December 2026 Examination tomorrow, October 31. Eligible candidates must complete their applications via ugcnet.nta.nic.in. The exam scheduled for December 14-18 and 21, 2026, to be held in CBT mode. By Swati Kumar 
 Fri, 30 Oct 2026 12:33 PM (IST) 
 Source: JND 
 UGC NET December 2026 (Image Credit: The Daily Jagran) Related Articles HighLights UGC NET December 2026 registration closes on October 31.
 Eligible candidates must apply online via ugcnet.nta.nic.in using DigiLocker.
 The exam is scheduled for December 14-18 and 21, 2026.
 UGC NET December 2026: The National Testing Agency (NTA) will close the registration process tomorrow for the UGC NET December 026 Examination. Candidates who are yet to complete their online registration must do so on or before October 31 through the official portal, ugcnet.nta.nic.in. Reportedly, over 8 lakh applicants have registered for the UGC NET December Examination, while only around 6 lakh of them have completed the fee payment process. NTA has further advised eligible candidates to not wait until tomorrow to avoid last-minute server issues.  
 Click Here To Apply 
 UGC NET December 2026 Registration Through DigiLocker 
 Candidates need to authenticate their personal and other key details using Aadhaar, a PAN card, or a driving licence. Here’s how you can complete the registration through DigiLocker. 
 Step 1: Visit the official website and select the “New Registration” link under the candidate activity section. 
 Step 2: Click on the option to log in or verify via DigiLocker.  
 Step 3: Select the valid ID that is currently linked with your DigiLocker, including Aadhaar Card, PAN Card, or Driving Licence. 
 Step 4: You will be redirected to the sign-in page. Enter your registered mobile number,  Aadhaar, or username, and input your 6-digit DigiLocker security PIN. Allow data sharing with the NTA.  
 Step 5: Your basic details will be automatically fetched from DigiLocker.  
 Step 6: Fill in the remaining sections and pay the application fee. 
 Step 7: After verifying your details, submit the form.

 UGC NET December 2026 Registration Fee 
 The registration fee varies as per the candidate’s category. The details are as follows:  
 Candidate Category 
 Application Fee 
 General / Unreserved 
 Rs 1,150 
 General-EWS / OBC-NCL 
 Rs 600 
 SC / ST / PwD / Third Gender 
 Rs 325 
 UGC NET December Exam Date 2026 
 As previously announced, the exam will be held from December 14 to 18 and on December 21, 2026. However, as per the amendments in the UGC NET December 2026 Information Bulletin released by the NTA, there are no buffer dates for the examination. UGC NET will be held in CBT mode across 83 subjects. Candidates can check the complete list of subjects from the official website, ugcnet.nta.nic.in.
